changes.title: Vincent Pastore, mob enforcer on ‘The Sopranos,’ dies at 80
changes.summary: Vincent Pastore, who played Tony Soprano’s best friend turned informant on HBO’s mob drama “The Sopranos,” has died, a representative confirmed Saturday.
